title: Deepen the Meeting Brief Generator behind one enrichment seam

labels.name: ready-for-agent
labels.description: Fully specified, ready for an AFK agent

body:
## What to build

Move Meeting Brief bundle policy, the completeness ledger, evidence selection, and prompt assembly inside the Brief Generator module implementation, exposing one deep interface that takes a frozen occurrence and returns a Brief. Today grasping one Brief forces bouncing across the 1842-line host, enrichment, compose, completeness, bundles, and two transcript-evidence modules with no locality, and the pure-selector unit tests pass while the real caller wiring in the host Run is reachable only through slow end-to-end journeys. After this ticket the host keeps schedule and routes only; everything that decides Brief content lives behind the one interface and is tested through it.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] One Brief Generator interface takes a frozen occurrence and returns a Brief; bundle policy, completeness ledger, evidence selection, and prompt assembly are implementation detail
- [ ] The host file is substantially smaller and holds schedule/routes/wiring only (no content decisions)
- [ ] Caller-wiring cases previously reachable only via e2e journeys are covered by tests through the new interface
- [ ] Existing meeting-brief and meeting-wizard journey tests still pass
- [ ] `npm run check` is green

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).

title: Retry, poll, unlink, and delete Google-linked Tasks

labels.name: ready-for-agent
labels.description: Fully specified, ready for an AFK agent

body:
## Parent

#172

## What to build

Deliver per-Task retry, Retry all failed links, synchronization at startup, Tasks-open, local-change, five-minute, and Refresh triggers, authentication pause behavior, isolated failures, unlinking, and both linked-Task Trash choices.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Per-Task retry reuses the canonical Task and cannot duplicate a successful remote record.
- [ ] Retry all targets failed links only and does not silently resolve missing, conflicted, or changed-externally links.
- [ ] Startup, Tasks-open, local-change, five-minute, and explicit Refresh triggers use one idempotent synchronization path.
- [ ] Authentication failures pause automatic retry until reconnection; transient failures remain manually and automatically retryable.
- [ ] One failing link never blocks synchronization of another Task.
- [ ] Trashing a linked Task asks whether to delete the external record or preserve and unlink it, with external deletion preselected.
- [ ] External deletion failure remains recoverable in Trash, and permanent local deletion still requires an explicit warning.
- [ ] `npm run check` is green.

## Blocked by

- #176 — Trash, restore, and permanently delete Tasks
- #186 — Resolve Google content drift and completion conflicts

Prove the same External Task Drift and Task Link Conflict behavior for Asana without mapping the Workspace Responsible Person to an Asana assignee.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Asana-side title, notes, or due-date changes create External Task Drift without implicit local overwrite.
- [ ] Restore app version, Use external values, and Remove link resolve drift through the shared contract.
- [ ] Competing completion-state changes create Task Link Conflict.
- [ ] Use app status, Use external status, and Remove link resolve status conflict only after provider success.

body:
## Parent

#172

## What to build

Send one owner-only weekly email containing the current Weekly Summary and deterministic Upcoming Meeting list, with durable once-per-week delivery receipts, retry after failure, and no second email when later Meetings complete.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The Monday email targets only the configured owner.
- [ ] The content includes the current Weekly Summary and deterministic Upcoming Meeting list.
- [ ] A durable receipt prevents more than one successful weekly delivery.
- [ ] Generation or Gmail failure remains retryable and does not record false success.
- [ ] Later Meeting completion updates the tab without sending another email.
- [ ] Stale or missing Summary content follows the same explicit degraded-state rules as the Weekly tab.
- [ ] `npm run check` is green.

## Blocked by

- #196 — Persist and refresh Weekly Summaries without duplicate model calls

## Parent

#172

## What to build

Complete the contract phase of the expand-contract migration by removing positional Done, Dismiss, and drop behavior, whole-Debrief Task creation, legacy receipt writes, and production dual-write after every legacy state has a canonical replacement.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All production Action Item decisions address stable Action Item identities rather than array indexes.
- [ ] Whole-Debrief publication cannot create Google Tasks or canonical Tasks.
- [ ] Legacy Done, Dismiss, drop alias, bulk Task creation, and receipt write paths are absent from production composition.
- [ ] Old Run files remain readable as historical records.
- [ ] New Task and Action Item changes write only canonical stores plus deliberate External Task Link synchronization.
- [ ] A regression suite proves no remaining caller performs legacy dual-write.
- [ ] `npm run check` is green.

## Blocked by

- #182 — Make Meeting Debrief email-only and non-expiring
- #183 — Migrate legacy local action review into canonical records
- #188 — Migrate app-created Google Task receipts without importing the account
